You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-every-detail|COREMERCH guide to creators]], the payment layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online without relying on conventional payment processors is crucial for digital creators restricted by platform limitations. The current landscape often forces creators into disadvantageous situations, where high fees eat into profits. By utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can maintain full control over your sales, accept cryptocurrency payments with minimal fees, and ensure that your earnings are maximized.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of various components like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This infrastructure allows automatic delivery of your beats upon payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth transaction experience. With a focus on ownership, once deployed, you hold full control over your setup without ongoing subscriptions or reliance on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators, especially musicians and producers in countries where traditional payment systems are limited. If you create beats, you need a way to monetize your work without excessive fees and restrictions. This infrastructure empowers you to sell directly to your audience, bypassing the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, thus enabling you to scale your business effectively.
Gumroad takes 10% on sales; NOWPayments only charges 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components include a free hosting platform for your online store, a backend solution for order management, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages will serve your website, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the automation of order processing. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a mere 0.5% transaction fee, significantly lower than competitors like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, select your hosting platform and set up your online store. Next, implement the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup will allow you to begin selling beats quickly and efficiently. For comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain more of your earnings with a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re interested in building and scaling your digital store, explore related searches that highlight how to sell digital downloads without platform fees. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers essential resources, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to establish your sovereign commerce stack. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, avoiding their high fees.

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and many others, providing your customers with flexible payment options.

Utilizing NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions provides an added layer of security. Payments are confirmed on-chain, reducing the risk of chargebacks and ensuring reliable transactions.
